name: purmemo-mcp
description: Persistent AI memory + workflows for Claude. Save conversations, recall context, and run memory-powered workflows across every session.
long_description:
pūrmemo gives Claude a memory that persists across sessions and structured workflows powered by your memory.

**What it does:**
- **Save** — Store conversations with explicit replace/append semantics. The `mode` parameter on `save_conversation` controls update behavior: `mode="append"` concatenates new content with a timestamped separator (true living document); `mode="replace"` overwrites (one-shot snapshot).
- **Recall** — Search and surface relevant memories when you need them
- **Workflows** — Run 15+ memory-powered workflows (PRD, debug, sprint, growth, etc.) pre-loaded with your context
- **Auto-capture** — Works silently in the background, capturing every session
- **Cross-platform** — Memories from Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Chrome extension, and more — all in one place

**Tools included:**
- `save_conversation` — Save any conversation to your memory (with `mode: 'replace' | 'append'`)
- `save_artifact` — Save artifacts (research reports, tables, specs) linked to conversations
- `recall_memories` — Search your memory with natural language
- `get_memory_details` — Retrieve a full conversation by ID
- `discover_related_conversations` — Find related memories across all platforms
- `get_user_context` — View memory stats and recent activity
- `run_workflow` — Run memory-powered workflows (PRD, debug, sprint, etc.)
- `list_workflows` — Browse all available workflows by category
- `share_memory` — Share a memory publicly with a shareable link
- `recall_public` — Search publicly shared memories from all users
- `get_public_memory` — Retrieve a publicly shared memory by ID
- `report_memory` — Report inappropriate or harmful public memories

api_key.title: pūrmemo API Key
api_key.description: Your API key from app.purmemo.ai. Go to Settings → API Keys to generate one.

tools.name: save_conversation
tools.description: Save a complete conversation as a persistent memory. Supports mode='replace' (default, overwrites existing) or mode='append' (concatenates with timestamped separator — true living document).

tools.name: save_artifact
tools.description: Save an artifact (research report, table, spec) linked to a conversation

tools.name: commit
tools.description: Persist a commitment-shaped artifact (PRD, ADR, spec, OKR) as a queryable memory — used by /prd, /decide, /spec slash commands

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Generate a state-shaped artifact for a topic from your saved memories — used by /snapshot slash command

tools.name: snapshot_sources
tools.description: Fetch citation bundle + conflict detection for a topic so the LLM can synthesize a snapshot in-context (Step 1 of MCP snapshot path, ADR-032 Amendment A)

tools.name: save_snapshot
tools.description: Persist a synthesized snapshot as a draft (Step 3 of MCP snapshot path, ADR-032 Amendment A)

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Read an existing canonical snapshot into context — fast, no LLM calls

tools.name: accept_snapshot
tools.description: Promote a draft snapshot to canonical, superseding the prior canonical for this topic

tools.name: recall_memories
tools.description: Search your memory with natural language queries

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.description: Browse the memory map: the user's project/theme hierarchy, or open a cluster and list its member memories. Read-only.

tools.name: get_memory_details
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a saved memory

tools.name: discover_related_conversations
tools.description: Find related memories across all platforms

tools.name: get_user_context
tools.description: View memory stats and recent activity

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Run a memory-powered workflow (PRD, debug, sprint, growth, etc.) with your context pre-loaded

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: Browse all available workflows organized by category

tools.name: share_memory
tools.description: Share a memory publicly with a shareable link

tools.name: recall_public
tools.description: Search publicly shared memories from all users

tools.name: get_public_memory
tools.description: Retrieve a publicly shared memory by ID

tools.name: report_memory
tools.description: Report inappropriate or harmful public memories

tools.name: get_acknowledged_errors
tools.description: Fetch acknowledged production errors awaiting investigation

tools.name: save_investigation_result
tools.description: Save error investigation results for audit trail

tools.name: generate_handoff_brief
tools.description: Generate a surgical context brief for new AI sessions — AI already knows where you left off

tools.name: save_test_result
tools.description: Save a test run result linked to a conversation

tools.name: get_test_results
tools.description: List recent test results for a project, newest first. Pairs with save_test_result.

tools.name: get_artifacts
tools.description: List artifacts linked to a parent conversation. Pairs with save_artifact.

tools.name: get_investigations
tools.description: List error investigation results (admin). Pairs with save_investigation_result.

tools.name: get_next_task
tools.description: Get the next pending task from your queue

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task complete with optional notes
